description: Make a new sound effect from a description when the library has nothing suitable (search_sounds has no full match and its closest sounds do not suit; it then returns generate_available). Needs an SFXMint API key; one credit per generation of up to four takes, given back if not one take can be made. Returns CC0 WAV files (signed links valid 15 minutes) with SHA-256 and seed; if they are not ready within about 25 seconds, it returns the order id for get_generation. AI-generated: the user should listen before use.

duration_s.description: Longest length in seconds. Leave it out and SFXMint chooses from the description; either way the silence before and after the sound is cut, so a take can be shorter

enhance.description: Let SFXMint rewrite a short or unclear idea ('coin', 'level complete') into a full sound description first; a clear description still goes as written (default false: the prompt is used as written). The result gives the rewrite it used, if any.

prompt.description: One sound, in English: a short noun phrase that ends with the sound itself, e.g. 'heavy wooden door slam' or 'bright rising three-note chime'. Name what is heard, not what it is for; leave out no/not/without, lengths (use duration_s) and 'sound effect'. Add a place (large hall, distant, outdoors) only when it matters. For a one- or two-word idea, set enhance.

variations.description: How many takes to make (default 4; the price is the same)

name: generate_sound
